FROM ast_device d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.shipment_time IS NOT NULL AND d.sn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.sn) <> ''
AND (d.sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR () LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.sn, d.product_code, AS product_model, d.conp_version
ORDER BY d.sn, d.id LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
